en.name: Saucisson sec, sliced
en.summary: Sliced saucisson sec is the same sausage as the one that hangs happily in a cellar, but not the same food to store. Unopened packs keep 2 weeks refrigerated to their printed date; once opened, 3–5 days. Frozen they run 1–2 months. All three figures are borrowed from pre-packaged salami, not published for saucisson.
en.pantry: Sliced saucisson is a chilled product and does not belong in a cupboard, even though the whole sausage it came from does. Slicing turns a small, dry, protected surface into a large, thin, freshly handled one — the moment where post-curing contamination and rapid oxidation both come in — and a modified-atmosphere pack keeps that surface far wetter than the sausage it was cut from. Bring it out only to warm on the plate for a few minutes before serving.
en.fridge: Unopened vacuum or modified-atmosphere packs keep 2 weeks at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, to the printed date. Lay them flat; a pack that has puffed up has lost its seal. After opening, the number that matters is 3–5 days, and it is much shorter than people expect from a sausage that needs no fridge when whole. Re-wrap the slices tightly with their faces touching and eat them soon — they go brown, waxy and hard at the edges long before they become unsafe.
en.freezer: A compromise at 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). The fat oxidises and the texture goes greasy, so thawed slices belong in a stew or on a pizza rather than on a board. Freeze them interleaved with baking paper, bagged flat with the air pressed out, and label the bag. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; these months are a quality judgement, not a documented limit.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, still wrapped, and use within a day or two. Never on the counter, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: Slices gone uniformly grey-brown instead of red with clean white fat.
Slime or a tacky film on the slices.
A rancid, old-oil smell or a sour ammonia one.
A pack that was puffy, leaking or warm on the shelf before you bought it.
tips: Buy the piece rather than the packet if you eat charcuterie slowly.
Write the opening date on the pack; three to five days is the number people miss.
Stack slices face to face when re-wrapping so less surface meets the air.
Do not decant slices into an open bowl in the fridge — they dry out within hours.

faq.q: How long do sliced saucisson or salami keep after opening?
faq.a: 3–5 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, tightly re-wrapped. The unopened figure does not carry over.

faq.q: Do unopened packs of sliced saucisson need refrigerating?
faq.a: Yes — 2 weeks at 4 °C or below, to the printed date. They are chilled packs, unlike the whole sausage.
For 1–2 months, but it is a compromise. Use thawed slices in cooking rather than on a board.

faq.q: Is sliced dry sausage safe in pregnancy?
faq.a: Dried, salted deli meats are the safer class, but that safety rests on the product being dry — and thin slices in a humid pack are much less dry at the surface than the salami they came from. Heating them through is the cautious option.

zh.name: 法式乾香腸切片
zh.summary: 切片的 saucisson sec 和那條吊在地窖裡好好的香腸是同一種肉，但保存上完全是兩回事。未開封的包裝冷藏 2 週、以標示日期為準；開封後 3～5 天；冷凍 1～2 個月。這三個數字都借自「預包裝莎樂美腸」，不是專為法式乾香腸公布的。
zh.pantry: 就算它來自一條可以常溫吊掛的香腸，切片本身是冷藏品，不該放櫥櫃。切片把一個小而乾燥、受保護的表面，變成一大片又薄又剛被經手過的新切面——那正是熟成後污染與快速氧化同時發生的時刻——而充氣包裝又讓這個表面比原本那條香腸濕得多。只在上桌前拿出來回溫幾分鐘。
zh.fridge: 未開封的真空包或充氣包放 4 °C 以下可放 2 週，以包裝標示日期為準。請平放；鼓起來的包裝代表封口已經失效。開封後真正重要的數字是 3～5 天，而且比大家預期的短很多——畢竟整條的時候它根本不用冰。請把切片面對面緊緊重包並盡快吃完；它在變得不安全之前，早就先變褐、發蠟、邊緣發硬了。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 1～2 個月，是一種妥協。油脂氧化、口感變膩，解凍後的切片適合丟進燉菜或鋪在披薩上，不適合擺冷盤。冷凍時用烘焙紙一片片隔開、平放裝袋壓出空氣，袋上標好日期。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，這裡的月數是品質判斷，不是有出處的上限。
zh.thawing: 維持包裝放冷藏解凍，一兩天內用完。不要放室溫，也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 切片整片均勻轉灰褐，而不是紅肉配乾淨的白色油花。
切片發黏、表面有一層黏膜。
聞起來有油耗味，或發酸的氨味。
買之前包裝就已經鼓起、滲液，或在常溫架上放到發溫。
tips: 冷肉吃得慢的話，買整條不要買切片包。
在包裝上寫開封日；三到五天是最多人忽略的數字。
重新包裝時把切片面對面疊好，接觸空氣的面積才小。
不要把切片倒進敞開的碗放冰箱——幾小時就乾掉了。

faq.q: 乾香腸／薩拉米切片開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下、重新包緊，3～5 天。未開封的期限不會延續到開封之後。

faq.q: 未開封的乾香腸切片需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 需要——4 °C 以下 2 週，以標示日期為準。它和整條香腸不同，是冷藏包裝品。

faq.q: 乾香腸切片可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以放 1～2 個月，但是妥協。解凍後請拿去入菜，不要擺冷盤。

faq.q: 孕婦可以吃乾香腸切片嗎？
faq.a: 乾燥鹽漬類的冷肉屬於相對安全的一類，但那份安全建立在「夠乾」之上——而濕潤包裝裡的薄切片，表面比它原本那條香腸濕得多。最保險的做法是加熱到全熱再吃。
